messages.en:
Swordsman Newsletter {Symbol:10}1
    Some Walls Go Boom...
It may look like a regular wall, but
it may be something you can blow up.
There's actually an easy way to tell.
And I'm here to teach you!
{Color:Blue}Build up the power in your sword and
start stabbing the wall.{Color:White}
If you pay attention, you'll find that
some spots make a different sound!
{Choice:03:0A}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
messages.es_ref:
{Color:Green}Lección de Tesshin I
{Color:White}"Cómo saber si puedes volar un muro"
Ya sabes que puedes hacer volar
muros con {Color:Red}bombas{Color:White}. Hoy te enseñaré
algo más. Intenta acumular fuerza en
la espada y después {Color:Blue}golpea el muro{Color:White}.
Según como suene, podrás o no hacer
volar ese muro con una bomba.
¿Qué te ha parecido?
{Choice:03:0A}Seguiré leyendo {Choice:FF}Me aburro

Swiftblade's Gossip Column
The Magical Boomerang...
Somewhere in Hyrule, you can find an
incredibly handy {Color:Red}boomerang{Color:White}.
It's designed so you can change its
direction after you throw it!
Or so I've been told.
But it's just a rumor...
{Choice:03:0C}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough

{Color:Green}Las ocho maravillas de Hyrule
{Color:White}El {Color:Red}bumerán mágico{Color:White}...

hay un bumerán mágico que podrás
controlar a tu antojo...
Aunque sólo es un rumor...
¿Qué te ha parecido?
{Choice:03:0C}Seguiré leyendo {Choice:FF}Me aburro

messages.en:
Swiftblade, Signing Off!
That's it for our first issue!
We plan to bring you helpful questing
hints every week, rain or shine.
Be sure to check with your local
post office for future issues!
See you in issue 2!
Until next time, warriors!
messages.es_ref:
{Color:Green}Epílogo de Tesshin{Color:White}
Espero que te haya gustado mi
primera lección. En la siguiente,
te enseñaré nuevos trucos para
mejorar tus técnicas de lucha.

¡Nos vemos en la lección II!
¡Adiós!

messages.en:
Swordsman Newsletter {Symbol:10}2
    This Year's Must-Have Item!
Have you seen those sparks that move
along walls?
Your sword doesn't work, so maybe
you've just given up fighting them.
But have you tried ALL your items?
Like...what about your boomerang?
Give that a shot! You might be
surprised at the results!
{Choice:03:0E}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
messages.es_ref:
{Color:Green}Lección de Tesshin II
{Color:White}"El objeto del año"
¿Has visto esos enemigos cargados
de electricidad que se mueven por
las paredes? ¿Cómo te enfrentarás
a ellos si no llegas con tu espada?
{Color:Blue}¡Prueba todos los objetos que
tengas a tu alcance!{Color:White} ¿Has visto ya
todo lo que puedes hacer con el
bumerán?
¿Qué te ha parecido?
{Choice:03:0E}Seguiré leyendo {Choice:FF}Me aburro

messages.en:
Swiftblade, Signing Off!
Issue 2 is out the door!
We've got our first reader letter!
Let's answer it now!
"Hey, Swiftblade, what's your best
feature?"
That would be my eyebrows! I spend
a lot of time grooming these suckers!
See you in issue 3!
Until next time, warriors!
messages.es_ref:
{Color:Green}Epílogo de Tesshin{Color:White}
¡Gracias a vuestra inspiración,
he terminado la lección II!
Recibo muchos correos vuestros
con dudas.
Ahora mismo contestaré a uno:
"¿Cuál es su mayor atractivo?"
"Sin ninguna duda... ¡{Color:Blue}mis cejas{Color:White}!"
¡Nos vemos en la lección III!
¡Adiós!

messages.en:
Swordsman Newsletter {Symbol:10}3{Color:Green}
    {Color:White}Got a Bone to Pick?
You're sure to run into more than
a few skeletons on your journey.
That's why this week's newsletter is
dedicated to all you bone-breakers!
A good, solid whack to the head should
do the trick. That's their weak spot!
Try smacking them with a beam
from your {Color:Red}Cane of Pacci{Color:White}.
You should also try your {Color:Red}Gust Jar{Color:White}.
That head should just pop right off!
They go all to pieces once they
lose their head.
{Choice:03:12}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
messages.es_ref:
{Color:Green}Lección de Tesshin III
{Color:White}"¡Hazles perder la cabeza!"
¿Has visto a los esqueletos?
Sí, sí, esos que te lanzan huesos.
Seguro que ya has visto que la
espada no sirve de mucho contra ellos.
¡Su punto débil es la cabeza!
¡Intenta darles con el {Color:Red}bastón revés{Color:White}
o aspirarlas con el {Color:Red}jarrón mágico{Color:White}!
¡Perderán la cabeza y {Color:Blue}no podrán verte{Color:White}!
¿Qué te ha parecido?
{Choice:03:12}Seguiré leyendo {Choice:FF}Me aburro

messages.en:
Teach us, Teacher!
Those darn Bob-ombs!
If you hit them with your sword, they'll
run all over the place and explode!
But don't you worry. This newsletter's
here to teach you how to cope!
Your best bet is arrows!
One shot can take them down!
You can fire from a safe distance,
too! There's also your Gust Jar...
Draw them in and shoot them out, and
they'll even blow up whatever they hit!
{Choice:03:13}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
messages.es_ref:
{Color:Green}¡Otro truco del maestro Tesshin!
{Color:White} 
¿Te has encontrado ya con estos
enemigos que explotan como bombas?
Lo mejor es {Color:Blue}darles con una flecha{Color:White}
antes. Después hazlos volar con el
{Color:Red}jarrón mágico{Color:White} y que exploten, pero
lejos...
¿Qué te ha parecido?
{Choice:03:13}Seguiré leyendo {Choice:FF}Me aburro

messages.en:
Swiftblade, Signing Off!
We've got more reader mail this week!
"Hey, Swiftblade! How many siblings
do you have?"
There are nine of us, not counting
the ghost of Swiftblade the First.
I'm the oldest, but again, that's if you
don't count Swiftblade the First!
See you in issue 4!
Until next time, warriors!!!!
messages.es_ref:
{Color:Green}Epílogo de Tesshin{Color:White}
¡Contestaré a una pregunta de
un lector! 
"¿Cuántos hermanos tiene, maestro?"
"{Color:Blue}Soy el mayor de diez hermanos{Color:White}."
¡Nos vemos en la lección IV!
¡Adiós!

messages.en:
Swordsman Newsletter {Symbol:10}4
    Seek Out the Strong!
Have you ever seen a golden monster?

When you fuse Kinstone pieces, you
might get the rare chance to meet one.
They're much stronger than the
regular version of that monster.
Of course, if you beat one of 'em,
you'll get something REALLY good!
If you see one, go fight it instantly!
Just drop everything and go!
{Choice:03:16}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
messages.es_ref:
{Color:Green}Lección de Tesshin IV
{Color:White}"Enfréntate al más fuerte"
¿Has visto a un enemigo que brilla
como el oro? Aparece a veces
cuado pruebas suerte con tus
piedras. Es seguramente el enemigo
más fuerte al que te puedes enfrentar,
pero {Color:Blue}la recompensa valdrá la pena{Color:White}.
¿Qué te ha parecido?
{Choice:03:16}Seguiré leyendo {Choice:FF}Me aburro

messages.en:
Teach us, Teacher!{Color:Green}
{Color:White}  Coping with a Thorny Situation
Those thorny little thorn monsters!
Your sword doesn't hurt 'em at all!
But if you bump 'em with your
{Color:Red}shield {Color:White}up, they'll totally flip!
There are other ways, though.
Flip 'em with a {Color:Red}bomb{Color:White}!
Or your {Color:Red}Cane of Pacci{Color:White}!
Or with a well-placed {Color:Red}Down Thrust{Color:White}!{Color:Blue}
{Color:White}How's that for options? Your head must
be swimming at the possibilities!
{Choice:03:17}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
messages.es_ref:
{Color:Green}¡Otro truco del maestro Tesshin!
{Color:White} ¿Y si el enemigo tiene pinchos?...
Lo mejor que puedes hacer es darle
la vuelta. Prueba con tu escudo.
Si no, con el {Color:Red}bastón revés{Color:White}. También
puedes probar con una {Color:Red}bomba{Color:White} o
con una {Color:Red}estocada{Color:White}.
No dirás que no te he dado opciones...
¿Qué te ha parecido?
{Choice:03:17}Seguiré leyendo {Choice:FF}Me aburro

messages.en:
Swiftblade, Signing Off!
I went to {Color:Green}Lon Lon Ranch {Color:White}the other day.
I saw the ghost of Swiftblade the First
defeat a cow with his bare hands!
It was kind of sad, really...

bandages? It tries to grab you?

messages.en:
Swordsman Newsletter {Symbol:10}7
    For Real Swordsmen Only
You know the Roll Attack, right?
Yeah, the one you do midroll!
I bet Grayblade told you to attack
just as you finish the roll, right?
Well, actually, you can do it just as
you start the roll, too!
But the timing is very tricky!
You can do it! Hone your skill!
The journey of a thousand miles begins
with a single step! Or...something!
{Choice:03:22}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
messages.es_ref:
{Color:Green}Lección de Tesshin VII
{Color:White}"¡Movimientos encadenados!"

y después clavas tu espada como te
enseñó Tosshin. También puedes dar un
{Color:Blue}golpe con la espada antes de realizar
este ataque{Color:White} y unir dos golpes...
Cuesta, pero practicando lo lograrás.
¿Qué te ha parecido?
{Choice:03:22}Seguiré leyendo {Choice:FF}Me aburro

Hit them with that {Color:Red}Cane of Pacci{Color:White}!

{Color:Red}jarrón mágico{Color:White}.

messages.en:
Swiftblade, Signing Off!
The next one is our last issue!
After that, it'll be time for me to put
down my pen.
As much as I like writing, I'm a
teacher at heart.
But I know you'll miss me when I'm
gone. I'm like a star! A superstar!
Issue 8, the last one, is coming soon!
Hope you're looking forward to it!
Until next time, warriors!!!!
messages.es_ref:
{Color:Green}Epílogo de Tesshin{Color:White}

llegando al {Color:Blue}final del curso{Color:White}.

mis clases de esgrima tradicionales.
¡Nos vemos en la lección VIII!
¡Adiós!

messages.en:
Swordsman Newsletter {Symbol:10}8
    The Way to the Sacred Blade
Have you ever wished you could unleash
your {Color:Red}Spin Attack {Color:White}a little faster?
Or perhaps split faster? Or maybe you
wanted a longer {Color:Red}Great Spin Attack{Color:White}?
It's only natural to want these things.
Every warrior wants to be his best!
So now for some good news! I haven't
confirmed it, but there MAY be a way!
All of these things could be yours if
you only figure out how to do it!
{Choice:03:26}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
messages.es_ref:
{Color:Green}Lección de Tesshin VIII
{Color:White}"¡El camino de la espada!"
¿Quieres realizar el {Color:Red}ataque
circular{Color:White} con más rapidez?
¿Rellenar tu {Color:Red}medidor de
divisón{Color:White} a más velocidad?
¿Poder realizar el {Color:Red}gran ataque
circular{Color:White} durante más tiempo?
Dicen que hay maestros capaces
de estas hazañas. {Color:Blue}Si tienes mucha
suerte, igual consigues hablar
con ellos alguna vez{Color:White}.
¿Qué te ha parecido?
{Choice:03:26}Seguiré leyendo {Choice:FF}Me aburro

messages.en:
Swiftblade, Signing Off!
That's all the news for you!
If you get lonely, just come over
and spar for a while!
And thanks for reading! I hope you've
enjoyed it as much as I have.
And now, let me sign off one final time
with that oh-so-familiar farewell...
Until next time, warriors!!!!

¡Gracias por vuestro apoyo!
¡Adiós!
